topic: Types And Architectures Of Ai Agents Sme

asset_1.asset_suggestion: An AI agent decision dashboard interface representing automated software management and execution tools. Its non-trivial structure comprises a top application bar with agent status metrics, a central evaluation pane displaying trade-off scoring indicators for efficiency, cost, and confidence, an action selection panel comparing trade-off options such as detailed diagnostics versus summary generation, and a baseline execution log stream. These distinct functional sections provide structural modularity for displaying dynamic utility values and decision states within a unified interface frame.
asset_1.construction_paragraph: The AI agent decision dashboard interface is constructed as a modular, high-fidelity software execution visual asset that models real-time trade-off scoring and dynamic action routing within a unified interface frame. The foundation layer consists of a dark navy main chassis container (`#0F172A`) featuring a dual-stroke bezel (`#1E293B` outer boundary with a `#334155` inner inset border) and a subtle drop-shadow backdrop rect to anchor the panel within the scene space. Built directly onto this chassis, the primary structure divides the workspace into four functional operational zones: a slim top application header bar, an upper-central dynamic evaluation pane, a lower-central comparative action selection grid, and a bottom horizontal execution log stream. The secondary structure populates each zone with authentic interface geometry: the top application bar embeds three colored window control dots (red, amber, green) on the top-left, a glowing green status indicator node (`#10B981`) labeled "AGENT-09 :: UTILITY_ENGINE", and system telemetry pills displaying memory and CPU overhead on the right; the central evaluation pane houses three horizontally stacked metric track assemblies representing Efficiency, Cost, and Confidence, each composed of a recessed track trough containing a color-coded dynamic progress fill (`#007ACC` cyan for Efficiency, `#F59E0B` amber for Cost, `#10B981` teal for Confidence) paired with precise floating numeric text chips ("94%", "$0.02", "0.89"); the action selection panel mounts two side-by-side rounded action cards—Card A ("Detailed Diagnostics") and Card B ("Summary Generation")—each featuring explicit parameter pills for latency, utility score, and execution cost; and the baseline execution log stream forms a recessed dark terminal box containing three lines of monospaced log output ("10:42:01 [EVAL] Option B score: 0.92 -> OPTIMAL"). The detail layer enhances visual realism through micro-indicators, including an illuminated "★ SELECTED OPTIMAL" cobalt badge (`#1D4ED8`) attached to Card B, a dimmed "✕ RULED OUT: HIGH COST" slate badge (`#94A3B8`) on Card A, hairline panel grid dividers, subtle gradient fills on progress sliders, and a active block cursor in the log stream. Structurally, the asset is engineered into a hierarchical VGroup tree rooted at the dashboard chassis, owning `app_bar_group`, `eval_pane_group`, `action_panel_group`, and `log_stream_group`, using strict relative anchoring (`next_to`, `align_to`, `inset`) to maintain absolute spatial consistency when scaled. The public contract exposes key structural references (`app_bar`, `evaluation_pane`, `action_card_a`, `action_card_b`, `log_stream`) and public getter methods (`get_action_card()`, `get_metric_meter()`, `get_log_stream()`) to enable seamless downstream state changes, utility updates, dynamic path highlights, or metric recalculations.
asset_1.sme_clearance_note: Strict clearance: x >= 760px (x >= -1.48 Manim). Right-side content canvas.

asset_2.asset_suggestion: A software interface asset representing an AI agent handoff and monitoring dashboard shell. It features a structured dashboard layout comprising a top system navigation bar, a main diagnostic notification area, confidence metric meters, telemetry log containers, and an engineer escalation action panel. The components are arranged hierarchically with distinct spatial separation between system status displays and human intervention controls, enabling independent recomposition of visual header bars, alert panels, and action trigger elements.
asset_2.construction_paragraph: The AI Agent Handoff and Monitoring Dashboard Shell is constructed as a sophisticated, modular UI console asset designed to visualize real-time agent diagnostics, system telemetry, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop intervention controls within a unified operational framework. At its foundation, the dashboard utilizes a large dark matte-finished rounded rectangle frame paired with an offset semi-transparent drop-shadow rectangle beneath it to create floating visual depth, bounded by an inner dual-tone stroke that simulates a chamfered glass-terminal bezel. The primary layout is organized into distinct functional zones: a top system navigation bar spanning the full width, a main diagnostic notification area anchored in the upper-center, a twin-meter confidence metric module on the mid-left, a telemetry log container on the mid-right, and an engineer escalation action panel occupying the lower deck. The top navigation bar houses an agent identity badge block, a pulsing system heartbeat dot indicator, and live operational status pill badges. The main diagnostic notification area contains a structured issue summary container designed to display critical handoff triggers alongside dynamic urgency tags. The confidence metric module features two specialized visualizers: an annular sector arc dial showing model certainty percentage around a centered numerical counter aligned to a crisp text baseline, and a horizontal segmented ratio bar indicating step progress across execution sub-tasks. The telemetry log container is built as a dark terminal shell populated with structured log line rows featuring micro-timestamps, system source tags, and color-coded log-level indicators. The engineer escalation action panel forms the bottom interface tier, housing an array of distinct command trigger buttons for primary escalation, manual agent override, and diagnostic rerun protocols. Secondary structural refinement is achieved through modular sub-card containers built from rounded rectangles with subtle inner fills and thin accent borders that visually isolate related data streams, reinforced by thin vector line dividers that enforce spatial hierarchy between monitoring panels and action controls. The detail layer enriches the asset with realistic instrumentation cues: multi-radius status LEDs constructed from solid core dots wrapped in translucent glow rings, procedurally calculated polar tick marks distributed around the annular confidence dial, micro-typography for system latencies and model version strings, and inner bevel strokes paired with high-contrast vector glyphs on the escalation buttons to convey mechanical tactile affordance. Architecturally, all elements are organized into a strict VGroup hierarchy where the top navigation bar, diagnostic panel, confidence meters, log container, and escalation panel exist as independent, semantically named sub-VGroups attached to the master shell container using strictly relative positioning anchor relationships. This structural decomposition exposes a robust public API including component accessors like `get_diagnostic_panel()`, `get_confidence_meter()`, and `get_escalation_button()`, enabling external scene logic to dynamically drive numerical counters, alter arc fill angles, re-color status indicators, or append log entries without compromising the baseline spatial integrity of the dashboard shell.
asset_2.sme_clearance_note: Strict clearance: x >= 760px (x >= -1.48 Manim). Right-side content canvas.
